title: MGD: Moment Guided Diffusion for Maximum Entropy Generation
abstract: arXiv:2602.17211v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generating samples from limited information is a fundamental problem across scientific domains. Classical maximum entropy methods provide principled uncertainty quantification from moment constraints but require sampling via MCMC or Langevin dynamics, which typically exhibit exponential slowdown in high dimensions. In contrast, generative models based on diffusion and flow matching efficiently transport noise to data but offer limited theoretical guarantees and can overfit when data is scarce. We introduce Moment Guided Diffusion (MGD), which combines elements of both approaches. Building on the stochastic interpolant framework, MGD samples maximum entropy distributions by solving a stochastic differential equation that guides moments toward prescribed values in finite time, thereby avoiding slow mixing in equilibrium-based methods. translated_title: MGD：矩引导扩散实现最大熵生成
translated_abstract: 从有限信息中生成样本是科学各领域的一个基本问题。经典的最大熵方法能够基于矩约束提供有原则的不确定性量化，但需要通过MCMC或朗之万动力学进行采样，这通常在高维情形下会表现出指数级的减速。相比之下，基于扩散模型和流匹配的生成模型能够高效地将噪声传输至数据分布，但理论保证有限，且在数据稀缺时容易过拟合。我们提出了矩引导扩散（MGD），它结合了两种方法的优点。基于随机插值框架，MGD通过求解一个随机微分方程来采样最大熵分布，该方程在有限时间内将矩引导至预设值，从而避免了基于平衡态方法中的缓慢混合问题。在大波动性极限下，我们形式化地证明了MGD收敛于最大熵分布。
tldr: 提出矩引导扩散（MGD），基于随机插值框架通过求解随机微分方程在有限时间内将矩引导至预设值，从而高效采样最大熵分布并避免高维慢混合问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Moment Guided Diffusion (MGD), which samples maximum entropy distributions by solving a stochastic differential equation that guides moments toward prescribed values in finite time, combining the efficiency of diffusion models with the theoretical guarantees of maximum entropy methods.
